usage: Original concept products. Black studio matte rendered with a live luma key in Three.js; not transparent PNGs and not actual SKU photos.

assets.prompt: Edit target: this concept product assortment. Keep the product cluster and photographic detail unchanged. Replace the ENTIRE grey checkerboard background with perfectly uniform pure RGB black (#000000), including spaces between products and within handles. No checkerboard at all. No shadows on the background, no floor, no pedestal, no horizon, no fog, no vignette. Preserve white/light product elements and the product colours. Soft cool edge light on the objects only. Keep all objects away from image edges with 8% empty black margins. Landscape 1536 by 1024 product matte for a 2.5D projection. This is a BLACK background request, not transparency.
